method: SQL-only warm runs: 1 warmup + 3 timed sequential walks/variant. Each walk includes one terminal empty SQL query (161 vs runtime160). No HTTP/authority/background. Count probes are separate untimed SQL. PostgreSQL: 10 timed queries/variant after warmup;20 authority rounds after warmup. No end-to-end optimized runtime measured.
limits: SQLite plain timed corpus only for variant parity; mixed/all-day, malformed, jumbo and revocation correctness not established for variants.
Sequential SQL variants are not a randomized paired performance suite.
PostgreSQL authority microbenchmark exercises only valid16-source grants; rejection behavior must be tested before implementation.
Background speed workload is a synthetic5ms ticker, not measured production demand.
Residual timings cannot distinguish pure network vs SDK vs client validation.
